steps.content: You don't think. You don't calculate the crumbling rifts underfoot or the threat of Manphist's attack.
You simply run for her.
The moment your fingers close around Hilda's ice-cold sleeve, it's like grasping a truth you've always known.
Her wrist is terrifyingly thin, a brittle twig in your grip, and you're afraid it will turn to dust if you hold any tighter.
...No. This is no illusion.
Her very existence has worn thin, fraying at the edges, ready to dissipate into the charged air.
Let go! LET GO! She chose this path! She belongs here! She belongs to ME!!
The ghostly shadows shriek in a greater frenzy as the rifts yawn wider.
A monstrous force pulls at you, a riptide of darkness trying to claim both your souls.
She cannot escape! She is a failure! Her destiny is to die here! She is MINE!
THIS IS HER CHOICE TOO!!!
You left her behind once! Don't offer hollow hope now! All she desires is ME!! Only DEATH!!

options: Refuse to let go, no matter what

steps.content: You have already braced yourself for this.
Your teeth grind together as your fingers lock around Hilda's wrist, pulling with every ounce of your strength in a desperate attempt to rip her back from the abyss of fate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop letting them torment you, Hilda.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you want redemption... if you really want to change something, then you have to live. Walk out of here and do what matters. Letting the Mania consume you in this place changes nothing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is your mind. You are its master. As long as you don't give up, these phantoms can never truly break you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's why I came back... to help you!
Crimson shackles erupt from your palm, shearing through the void-like Mania to pierce both your hands. They bind you together—a bond that, for now, defies all forces in this world or any other.
The ghostly shadows within the sludge recoil as if scorched, their advance broken. Now, they can only writhe at a distance, their forms twisting with helpless, mournful wails.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...So this is... your...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ..."<color=#fb9259>shackles</color>"...
She lifts her head, a faint smile gracing her features. Her voice, distant as an echo, carries not just relief, but a fragile note of joy.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...You really... weren't lying...
The roars of Mania fade, becoming hollow and muffled, suppressed by an immense, unseen force.
A mist begins to coil through the air, blurring your sight. Within it, her form slowly unravels, until all that remains is the cold, unyielding chill at the other end of your shackles.
